Name: Operating checking
Notes: Gifts, grant payments and online giving payouts land here; most bills are paid from here

Name: Reserve savings
Notes: Board-designated reserves. A board designation is not a donor restriction, so this money stays without donor restrictions

Name: Pledges receivable
Notes: Unconditional promises to give, recorded when the promise is made

Name: Grants receivable
Notes: Unconditional grants awarded but not yet paid

Name: Prepaid expenses
Notes: Insurance and subscriptions paid ahead, spread over the months they cover

Name: Donated goods held for distribution
Notes: In-kind goods received at fair value and not yet given out or used

Name: Furniture and equipment
Notes: Items above your capitalization threshold, at cost or at fair value if donated

Name: Accumulated depreciation
Notes: Contra account; carries a credit balance

Name: Accounts payable
Notes: Bills received and not yet paid

Name: Accrued payroll
Notes: Wages earned by staff and not yet paid at month end

Name: Payroll liabilities
Notes: Withholdings and employer taxes owed, from the payroll register

Name: Refundable advances
Notes: Cash received on a conditional grant before the condition is met (ASU 2018-08); moves to contributions when the barrier is cleared

Name: Deferred event revenue
Notes: Tickets sold for an event that has not happened yet

Name: Net assets without donor restrictions
Notes: Opening balance for unrestricted money; includes board-designated reserves

Name: Net assets with donor restrictions
Notes: Opening balance for restricted gifts and grants not yet spent or released

Name: Contributions without donor restrictions
Notes: General gifts, unrestricted grants and the gift part of event tickets

Name: Contributions with donor restrictions
Notes: Parent line. Post to a child line, never to the parent

Name: Contributions with donor restrictions: Example grant A
Notes: One child line per restricted grant or purpose. Rename to the grant, such as Adult tutoring grant 2026

Name: Contributions with donor restrictions: Example purpose B
Notes: A second restricted purpose, such as Summer reading. Add more children as needed

Name: Government grants
Notes: Use a child line per award if the agency asks for spending by award

Name: In-kind contributions
Notes: Donated goods and qualifying donated services at fair value, by journal entry. Ordinary volunteer hours are not recorded

Name: Special event revenue
Notes: The fair value of what attendees received, such as the dinner. The rest of the ticket is a contribution

Name: Program service fees
Notes: Tuition, fees for services and contract revenue from programs

Name: Investment income
Notes: Interest and dividends on reserve and investment accounts

Name: Net assets released from restriction: with donor restrictions
Notes: Debit side of a release when restricted money is spent on its purpose. Always posted with 4920

Name: Net assets released from restriction: without donor restrictions
Notes: Credit side of the same release. 4910 and 4920 net to zero in total

Name: Direct benefits to donors
Notes: The cost of meals, venue and gifts given to event attendees

Name: Salaries and wages
Notes: Parent line. Post to a function child

Name: Salaries and wages: Program
Notes: Form 990 Part IX column B

Name: Salaries and wages: Management and general
Notes: Form 990 Part IX column C

Name: Salaries and wages: Fundraising
Notes: Form 990 Part IX column D

Name: Salaries and wages: To allocate
Notes: Holding line during the month; the month-end allocation entry brings it to zero using timesheets

Name: Payroll taxes and benefits
Notes: Parent line. Post to a function child

Name: Payroll taxes and benefits: Management and general
Payroll taxes and benefits: To allocate
Notes: Allocated on the same basis as salaries

Name: Occupancy
Notes: Parent line. Post to a function child

Name: Occupancy: To allocate
Notes: Rent and utilities land here, then are split by floor space at month end

Name: Program supplies
Notes: Supplies used only in programs. Restricted spending also needs a release (4910 and 4920)

Name: Professional fees
Notes: Audit, legal and payroll service fees

Name: Fundraising costs
Notes: Mailings, donor database and event marketing

Name: Payment processing fees
Notes: Fees kept by online giving platforms, grossed up from the payout report

Name: Insurance
Notes: Directors and officers, general liability

Name: Depreciation
Notes: Allocate by function if the asset is used mostly in programs
